{
  "mutation_proposals": [
    {
      "target_block_id": "02",
      "target_block_family": "Service_Mapping",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 1,
      "reason": "Ensure strict grounding of service names and argument types to prevent schema violations and unknown services.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add a micro-rule to block 02 enforcing exact use of canonical service names and precise enum and numeric argument grounding.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "Use only canonical service names from service_list_snippet; for ENUM arguments, copy allowed enum values exactly; for numeric arguments, use unquoted numeric literals; read descriptor and argument bounds before selecting services or units."
    },
    {
      "target_block_id": "03",
      "target_block_family": "Output_Schema",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 1,
      "reason": "Prevent invalid JSON output and extraneous actions by enforcing strict output format and minimality.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add micro-rules to block 03 to enforce JSON-only output and emit only required actions.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "Return exactly one JSON object only; never emit markdown, prose, comments, or code fences; emit only actions required by the command, removing unrelated or duplicate actions."
    },
    {
      "target_block_id": "06",
      "target_block_family": "Temporal_Rule",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 1,
      "reason": "Improve temporal grounding and dataflow correctness for delayed or duration-based commands.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add micro-rules to block 06 to represent elapsed time with explicit state variables and bind sensor reads to variables for downstream use.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "Represent elapsed time with explicit state variables and comparisons; when reading values for reporting or control, bind to variables and use those variables in downstream actions."
    }
  ]
}

mutation_proposals.proposed_micro_rule: Return exactly one JSON object only; never emit markdown, prose, comments, or code fences; emit only actions required by the command, removing unrelated or duplicate actions.

mutation_proposals.reason: Improve temporal grounding and dataflow correctness for delayed or duration-based commands.
mutation_proposals.edit_instruction: Add micro-rules to block 06 to represent elapsed time with explicit state variables and bind sensor reads to variables for downstream use.
mutation_proposals.proposed_micro_rule: Represent elapsed time with explicit state variables and comparisons; when reading values for reporting or control, bind to variables and use those variables in downstream actions.
